lead.headline: MiCA Rules Reshape Euro Stablecoin Market as USDC Overtakes USDT
lead.tldr: Regulatory compliance is becoming the primary axis of competition in stablecoins, with USDC's MiCA alignment driving a 56% euro-trading market share flip that signals how EU policy will reprice liquidity access across crypto.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today the signals point to a hard split between assets that can absorb regulatory compliance costs and those that cannot, with implications for how we underwrite stablecoin infrastructure and exchange distribution over the next 18 months.

top_signals.title: Datavault AI stock plummets 50% after firm says it cannot withdraw bitcoin tied to $150 million deal
top_signals.summary: Datavault AI's stock price crashed by 50% after the company revealed it is unable to withdraw Bitcoin associated with a $150 million deal. The transaction involved Scilex purchasing shares of Datavault AI with payment made in Bitcoin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Datavault failure illustrates why deal structures with restricted Bitcoin withdrawal rights trade at a structural discount—this is precisely the counterparty and settlement risk that tokenized fund infrastructure is designed to eliminate.

top_signals.title: Robinhood Chain brings in $26 million as crypto revenue rises 20% in Q3
top_signals.summary: Robinhood's crypto revenue grew by 20% in Q3, bolstered by its Robinhood Chain which brought in $26 million. While general crypto trading revenue saw a slight dip, prediction markets contributed significantly with $173 million in revenue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Robinhood's $26 million chain revenue against $173 million from prediction markets shows where the actual user demand sits, and why exchanges are building proprietary chains to capture order flow rather than share fees with L1 validators.

top_signals.title: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets 27m
top_signals.summary: Ripple and Robinhood have expanded their partnership to integrate Ripple's USD-pegged stablecoin, RLUSD, into Robinhood's platform. This move aims to increase the accessibility of RLUSD for both retail and institutional users.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The RLUSD-Robinhood integration is a distribution play that tests whether Ripple's regulatory settlement can convert into retail market share before Circle's first-mover advantage compounds.

top_signals.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
top_signals.summary: Janus Henderson has launched a tokenized version of its Nasdaq-100 fund (JQQQ) utilizing Centrifuge's infrastructure. The fund is deployed on the Stellar network, marking a significant step in institutional adoption of on-chain assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Janus Henderson choosing Centrifuge and Stellar over Ethereum for a Nasdaq-100 tokenization signals that institutional issuers still prioritize cost and speed over ecosystem depth for vanilla fund wrappers.

top_signals.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
top_signals.summary: USDC has overtaken USDT as the dominant stablecoin for euro-paired trading, now capturing 56% of the market. This shift is driven by the implementation of MiCA regulations in the EU, which have negatively impacted USDT's liquidity and market share.
top_signals.why_it_matters: USDC's euro-market capture under MiCA is the first measurable instance of regulatory preference driving stablecoin liquidity migration, and it establishes a template for how other jurisdictions will reprice Tether's market position.

deals.summary: Canton-based trading platform Cancore has raised $7.2 million in a seed funding round. The round was led by Paper Ventures and dao5 and was conducted via agreements for the upcoming CNRX token.

Bitcoin mining infrastructure provider Luxor has raised $16 million to facilitate its expansion into the AI infrastructure sector. The funding round was led by CMT Digital and consists of both new funding and share sales.

on_the_radar.title: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices
on_the_radar.summary: BNY and Ripple are collaborating to explore the use of the XRP Ledger for tokenized trade finance and financing approved invoices. Additionally, BNY is expanding its custody support to include XRP and the RLUSD stablecoin.

on_the_radar.title: Galaxy Digital swings to $323 million quarterly profit, announces new $200 million share buyback
on_the_radar.summary: Galaxy Digital reported a quarterly profit of $323 million, marking a significant financial turnaround. The company also announced a new $200 million share buyback program to return value to shareholders.

on_the_radar.title: Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach: Report
on_the_radar.summary: South Korean cryptocurrency exchange Bithumb is investigating a security breach involving its internal communications system. The exchange is currently working to determine the extent of the data leak and what specific information was exposed.

on_the_radar.title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
on_the_radar.summary: VanEck has launched the Wealth Builder ETF, a diversified fund that combines traditional stocks and bonds with indirect Bitcoin exposure. The fund integrates a spot Bitcoin ETF alongside real assets to provide a balanced investment portfolio.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
on_the_radar.summary: The CFTC has filed a lawsuit against Utah officials to block their actions against prediction markets. The regulator alleges that Utah is attempting to usurp federal authority over the regulation of these markets.

on_the_radar.title: ETHGas: Institutional Blockspace on Ethereum
on_the_radar.summary: Delphi Digital explores ETHGas, a framework designed to provide institutional-grade blockspace on Ethereum. The system allows institutions to maintain compliance and execution control while utilizing Ethereum's shared settlement layer.

on_the_radar.title: 규제를 기다리지 않는 은행들: 유럽 MiCA가 제시하는 스테이블코인 실행 기준
on_the_radar.summary: The article discusses how European banks are proactively preparing for stablecoin implementation by following the standards set by the MiCA regulation. It examines the intersection of traditional banking and digital asset frameworks in the EU.

on_the_radar.title: Banks That Do Not Wait for Regulation: Europe’s MiCA as the Execution Standard for Stablecoins
on_the_radar.summary: The article discusses how European banks are proactively adopting the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation as a standard for stablecoin execution. It highlights the shift toward regulatory compliance as a competitive advantage for financial institutions entering the digital asset space.

worth_a_read.title: ETHGas: Institutional Blockspace on Ethereum
worth_a_read.note: Blockspace pricing and institutional execution on Ethereum remain poorly understood by most allocators; this piece likely contains the granular cost analysis needed to underwrite L2 versus L1 settlement economics.

worth_a_read.title: Why Now is the Time to Add and Hold BTC, Anthropic’s S-1, and Solana’s Alpenglow
worth_a_read.note: The BTC hold thesis combined with Solana's Alpenglow upgrade timing and Anthropic's S-1 framing suggests a useful synthesis of how crypto and AI infrastructure valuations are converging in institutional portfolios.

worth_a_read.title: Revolut faces Bank of England scrutiny over product approval process, reports say
worth_a_read.note: Revolut's Bank of England scrutiny on product approvals is a regulatory signal that matters for any fintech with banking ambitions, and the acquisition context makes this a case study in how licenses can attract oversight.

linkedin_post:
MiCA went live in June. By October, USDC had 56% of euro-paired stablecoin volume. Not because Circle marketed harder. Because Tether's structure could not absorb the compliance cost, and liquidity followed the path of least regulatory friction.

This is not a stablecoin story. It is a repricing story.

We underwrite stablecoin infrastructure on two variables: issuer compliance durability and exchange distribution reach. RLUSD's Robinhood integration today is Ripple's bet that regulatory settlement converts to retail pipes. Janus Henderson's Nasdaq-100 token on Centrifuge is the mirror bet—that institutions want regulated wrappers, not native DeFi complexity. Both assume the same thing: the next $100 billion in stablecoin supply will be issued by entities that regulators have already blessed, or can credibly threaten.

What kills this thesis? Tether secures a European e-money license and reverses the liquidity migration. What confirms it? Any Asian regulator copying MiCA's reserve-audit requirements and watching the same flip repeat in yen or won markets.

Robinhood's chain made $26 million. Its prediction markets made $173 million. The chain is infrastructure. The markets are demand. We watch where the revenue is, not where the press releases point.

The value is shifting to compliant rails. The question is whether the compliance premium is already priced in.
